localChanges: chore: lock the engine packages that announce cities growing, shrinking and starving

log: CityGrowth.grow()/shrink() only process the Grow/Shrink rules and nothing emitted, so a renderer listening for these events never heard them (civ-clone/web-renderer#400).
civ1-city:city/grow/emit, last of the Grow rules.
civ1-city:city/shrink/emit, while size > 0; a city shrunk to nothing is destroyed instead, which emits city:destroyed.
civ1-city:city/food-exhausted/emit, before the shrink, so famine is known before the shrinking (or destruction) it causes.
getRules for grow, shrink and food-exhausted take an Engine (last, defaulting to the instance); registerRules passes game.engine.
Uses core-city-growth's new grow/shrink cause (civ-clone/core-city-growth feat/growth-cause), so a listener can tell why a city's size changed (civ-clone/web-renderer#400):
famine shrinks with FoodExhausted (the rule type);
a lost defence shrinks with the Attack that won.
The emit rules send the cause as the event's second argument, `null` when nothing was given.
chore: require core-city-growth 0.1.6, which passes a grow/shrink cause
A city held at 10 without an Aqueduct shrinks with Aqueduct as the cause (core-city-growth feat/growth-cause), so a listener can tell it from other losses (civ-clone/web-renderer#400).
chore: require core-city-growth 0.1.6, which passes a grow/shrink cause
Passes a cause to CityGrowth#shrink (core-city-growth feat/growth-cause), so a listener can tell Settlers built and a nuclear strike from other losses (civ-clone/web-renderer#400).
chore: require core-city-growth 0.1.6, which passes a grow/shrink cause

As City#capture does: what a ruleset passes is up to it (the Settlers built, the attack lost, the rule type that starved the city), so a Grow or Shrink rule, and a listener the ruleset tells, can react to why the size changed (civ-clone/web-renderer#400). Nothing passed is null.
Grow and Shrink are now Rule<[CityGrowth, unknown], void>.
